L1_RESEARCH_DIRECTOR: the program has been optimizing the map instead of the territory: recent artifacts are about the research rather than being it, and map work produces commits and green gates at the same rate real work would

'no newly enabled arc' has become a self-fulfilling scheduler state, true only relative to an enumeration nobody was expanding -- disproved on 2026-08-22 when enumerating one more ledger obligation produced an executable arc immediately
the program has no definition of a good week, so maintenance and physics are indistinguishable at review time and the cheaper one wins by default
L2_OPERATIONS: the hourly loop's cheapest legal move is a reconcile, so it reconciles: six maintenance commits and zero new physics in one 24-hour window; the selection rule is the defect, not the loop
maintenance work creates the maintenance work: six propagation surfaces per swing are six future staleness sites and pointer repair is itself a legal next swing
concurrency is handled by luck: three write-races in one day, no lease, no lane partition, no declared ownership of shared surfaces
L3_WORKING_PHYSICIST: nobody is deriving anything: the last five Lean gates are finite algebra and hygiene, and all five left the source-to-proof delta unchanged
owner-exhaustion is being treated as a stop rather than a result; the correct response is a necessity theorem converting thirty negative results into one structural statement
the physics is gated on one object and the program acts as if it has seven: OWNER-B, D, E and F all presuppose OWNER-A
L4_EPISTEMICS: the probes check prose, not physics: three probe defect classes surfaced in this session alone (wrapped-prose substring checks, crash-not-detection, a predicate satisfiable by its own negation)
green gates are being read as evidence of progress; they certify self-consistency and propagation, not that the work mattered

the strongest negative results were mis-typed for ten days while the gate that detects it reported the problem in its own docstring: a gate nobody acts on converts a known defect into a permanent one with a green-looking process around it
L5_INFORMATION_ARCHITECT: surfaces rot because maintenance is manual and per-artifact; the 2026-08-22 derived-inventory fix is the template and has not been generalized
artifact frontmatter has become unreadable, with title fields running to hundreds of words carrying verdicts and caveats that belong in typed fields
six propagation surfaces per swing is at least three too many and is the write-amplification tax on every piece of science
L6_PORTFOLIO_ECONOMIST: cost per ledger point is not measured, so allocation is vibes
the cheap column is nearly exhausted and that is good news badly handled: the exhaustion point should be planned for in advance rather than met unprepared
the scorecard is worth keeping and L3.3 is wrong to disparage it: naming downstream owners is what makes it possible to price a proposal and to say a result discharges nothing
L7_SOURCE_CUSTODIAN: the binding constraint is input supply and the program will not say so: every artifact says 'unbuilt' and none says 'unbuildable from what we have', which are different statements the program has evidence for
the source register is used defensively rather than generatively: it polices kills but is never mined for registered claims with no ledger row
no decision procedure exists for declaring an import, so every candidate stays open forever at zero cost
L8_ADVERSARY: this session is itself the failure mode it keeps diagnosing: twelve artifacts, six audits of artifacts, two audits of audits, and an outside reader could not distinguish the program from a well-run documentation project
the delta instrument may become the next thing to game, since its probe checks that a delta exists rather than that it moved
the most likely true state is that GU cannot be advanced further without Weinstein, and the honest terminal move may be to write the exhaustion result
